description.value: Torquay Village Restaurant is an all-day brunch spot operating as part of The Village franchise in Victoria's Shelbourne Valley neighbourhood, just a short distance from Lambrick Park. The menu leans into creative eggs benedict variations, bagels, and directly traded, locally roasted coffee, and the business was voted Best Breakfast in the City in 2020. Both a dining room with patio and a takeout option are available, with takeout orders packed specifically for travel.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: bollard (2 spaces) at 97m; rack at 98m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active brunch restaurant at 4087 Shelbourne Street, Victoria, matching OSM address and phone. Takeout is explicitly offered ('Take out is available and we pack your brunch intentionally for travel'). No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site. A concern worth flagging: the OSM opening hours list Wed–Sun, while the website states 7 days a week — a discrepancy that may reflect stale OSM data; the website itself appears last updated in 2020.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag lists Wednesday–Sunday only, but the website states 'Open 7 days a week 8am–2pm' — one of the two is outdated and the discrepancy should be verified.

Website copyright footer reads '© The Village Restaurant - 2020' and all blog posts date to October 2020, suggesting the website has not been updated in several years; current operational details may differ.
OSM name is 'Torquay Village Restaurant' but the website consistently uses 'Torquay - The Village Restaurant' — minor branding mismatch worth noting.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible brunch restaurant with an active website and confirmed address and phone. A solid stop for touring cyclists wanting a sit-down or takeout meal.

wow_evidence: voted Best Breakfast in the City in 2020
